_note: FICTIONAL and ILLUSTRATIVE. The tool list is a placeholder: Snowflake and Databricks (data sharing) and an API come from the RFP; the rest are examples. Analytics tools (Chartmetric, SpotOnTrack, Soundcharts, Plates) were mentioned in the Merlin and IFPI interview; no partnership is implied. Use generic Lucide icons for tools, NOT brand logos. AI tools use the project's own AI icon (assets/ai-icon.svg). Visible to Enterprise (Dev) only; Premium sees the locked state.

addFlow.scopeNote: Scope: all markets in your access · all rows (Enterprise). Set by your access level.

testSuccess.title: Test delivery succeeded
testSuccess.text: 1,000 sample rows delivered in 4.2 s. Nothing is scheduled until you finish.

testFail.title: Test delivery failed
testFail.text: Authentication failed (401). Check the token secret, then try again.

addFlow.failureRule: If any secret field contains the text 'bad' (case-insensitive), the test fails. Otherwise it passes. This lets the presenter show both states.

done.title: {tool} is connected
done.text: First delivery is {firstDelivery}, after the weekly publication.

addFlow.onFinish: Prepend a new row to connections (status Active, last delivery 'Not yet delivered', detail 'First delivery Fri 30 Oct'), update the Active count tile, keep it in memory only.

reconnect: Power BI 'Reconnect' opens the add flow at step 2 (Authenticate) with fields prefilled except the secret. On success the row becomes Active and the Needs attention tile goes to 0.
availableGridRule: The 'Available connections' grid and the Choose tool step show ONLY tools with connected=false (currently 11). Connected tools (including Power BI, which needs attention) are managed in 'Your connections'. When a tool is connected, remove it from the grid; when a connection is removed, it returns to the grid.
